name: elagoht/feed
description: A collage plugin that serves RSS 2.0 and Atom 1.0 feeds.
setup:
Serves nothing until it has a feed: in `plugins.go`, replace `feed.New()` with `feed.New(feed.Feed{Title: "Blog", Link: "/", Items: posts})`, where `posts` is a `func(ctx context.Context) ([]feed.Item, error)` returning `feed.Item{Title: …, Link: "/blog/" + slug, Published: …}`.
With elagoht/markdown, make the items from `md.List(ctx, "")`.
Set `BASE_URL=https://your.site` where production runs, or the application does not start (`collage dev` sets it for you).
